best.label: Best picks
best.rule: the selections with the strongest evidence of winning across every section, one per player, at most two per game

instructions: Study every angle before choosing: defensive matchups, weather, injuries, confirmed starters, man-to-man matchups, stats, tendencies and defensive weak points, and any other variable the evidence calls for.
Do not let the odds determine or influence a selection: choose on evidence, then show the DraftKings price and what it implies.
Only DraftKings' actual posted lines. No alternate lines. No over/under on passing touchdowns.
Every section needs at least one selection; fill a section only with selections the research supports, up to its maximum.
Best picks are the selections with the highest evidence of actually winning, three to six of them, one per player, at most two from the same game.

availability.label: Availability: official report, practice participation, beat-writer notes, confirmed starters

weather.label: Weather at kickoff: wind, gusts, rain, temperature, roof

matchup.label: Defensive matchup: pass and run defense by EPA and success rate, pressure vs protection, tight-end coverage, defensive weak points

cornerbacks.label: Man-to-man matchups: shadow cornerback, slot vs wide, who guards whom

usage_form.label: Usage and form, last four games: routes, targets, carries, snap share trend, air yards

tendencies.label: Tendencies: pass rate over expected, pace, red-zone usage, how the offense attacks this defense

game_script.label: Game script: spread, total, pace, expected plays, who leads

line_movement.label: Line movement: opener vs now, with or without news

situational.label: Situational: rest, travel, short week, coordinator changes, resting starters

stadium.label: Stadium and surface effects (altitude, turf, dome)
